CLAIM: Short-term 5-day momentum exhibits statistically significant negative cross-sectional association (mean-reversion)
LIMITATION: High turnover and bid-ask spread friction impede direct monetization

CLAIM: OLS and Ridge linear regressions have negligible predictive rank correlation at H=5
LIMITATION: Linear specifications fail to capture non-linear threshold dynamics in bar geometry

CLAIM: Standard XGBoost GBDT achieves higher empirical Rank IC than linear models at H=5
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Naive t = 1.0558, p = 0.2919 (4x higher than OLS, but not statistically significant)
LIMITATION: The increment (+0.0044) is not statistically distinguishable from zero at alpha=0.05

CLAIM: Multi-model Stacking Blend M4 achieves Rank IC of 0.0085 with t-stat of 1.51 at H=5
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Actual test t-stat is 1.3126 (p=0.1903); 1.51 was mistakenly copied from rec summary
LIMITATION: Exploratory post-hoc feature expansion and model stacking; not statistically significant

CLAIM: Predictive rank association decays monotonically as forecast horizon expands from H=1 to H=21 days
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Monotonic decay across 308 trading days; 98.1% signal reduction by Day 21
LIMITATION: Ultra-short H=1 incurs daily rebalancing turnover friction

CLAIM: H=1 Champion Ensemble achieves statistically significant Rank IC on locked test data
VALUE: IC=0.0221, Test LS t=1.36, Val IC t=2.93
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Test Long-Short spread is not statistically significant (p=0.1756); Val IC was significant (p=0.0034)
LIMITATION: Post-hoc horizon switch; conflated validation vs test statistics in earlier drafts

CLAIM: Method B (Similarity-Only) generates positive excess return over market benchmarks
LIMITATION: Behavioral similarity alone provides zero alpha; indistinguishable from random selection

CLAIM: Method A (Prediction-Only) produces high arithmetic excess returns
LIMITATION: Driven entirely by positive right-tail skewness; top 5% of runs account for 102.9% of sum

CLAIM: Method A provides consistent outperformance for the median investor
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Wilcoxon test W = 342,720, p = 0.0159 (median significantly below benchmark)
LIMITATION: Method A underperforms the universe benchmark 52.46% of the time

CLAIM: Rank Fusion (Method C) dampens excess return dispersion and tracking error volatility
LIMITATION: Gross arithmetic excess return is compressed from +1.66% down to +0.16% (HAC t = 1.026)

CLAIM: Method C generates robust net excess returns after realistic transaction costs
METRIC: Net Excess Return after 20 bps friction
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Turnover is 83.75%; 20 bps round-trip friction eliminates alpha
LIMITATION: Only profitable if round-trip costs remain strictly below 18 bps

CLAIM: The machine learning models achieve 80% to 90% classification accuracy
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Continuous regression/ranking problem; classification accuracy is inapplicable
LIMITATION: Claiming 80%-90% accuracy is fabricated or conflated with AUC

CLAIM: Bar geometry and momentum features provide real causal signal explaining returns
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Observational association within fitted GBDT; no causal econometric identification
LIMITATION: Conflates temporal causality with economic structural causality

CLAIM: Method C2 (Volatility-Penalized Fusion) achieves statistically significant outperformance
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: t = 2.2403 exceeds critical threshold 1.96 on 1,220 runs
LIMITATION: Exploratory post-hoc formulation created to resolve Method A skewness

CLAIM: Level 2 Market-Aware LightGBM Huber Regressor achieves Rank IC of 0.0160 with +91.1% lift over baseline
METRIC: Test Mean Rank IC & HAC t-stat
LIMITATION: Lift is economically meaningful but not statistically significant at alpha = 0.05

CLAIM: Platt logistic scaling enables well-calibrated selective UP-call precision exceeding 65%
LIMITATION: Represents precision on selective upward calls; directional accuracy remains 56.89%

CLAIM: Method C (Hybrid Rank Fusion) provides 88.0% variance reduction across 6100 out-of-time portfolios
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Empirical measurement across 6,100 out-of-time recommendations (1,220 windows x 5 assets)
LIMITATION: Gross excess is +0.113% decaying to -0.014% net after 15 bps round-trip friction

CLAIM: Unconditional directional accuracy on daily OHLCV is strictly bounded near 51.6% due to low SNR
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Balanced accuracy = 50.17%, ROC-AUC = 0.4999, Brier = 0.24979 across 737,805 samples
LIMITATION: Unconditional >=60% accuracy on daily equities is unattainable on historical OHLCV data

CLAIM: Selective prediction yields up to 56.72% directional accuracy and 66.67% UP-call precision
STATISTICAL_EVIDENCE: Validation-frozen cutoffs; UP/Down spread reaches +12.08% at 6.76% coverage
LIMITATION: Selective directional accuracy falls short of 60%; 66.67% is precision under coverage trade-off
